==> certs/tls-backends.crtlist (plaintext, whole file)
/etc/switchyard/certs/wild-example-test.pem *.example.test

==> haproxy/haproxy.cfg (haproxy, whole file)
# Managed by Switchyard. Do not edit: changes are reported as drift.
# SE group: edge
# switchyard-render: sha256:acdeb97e2d471ce0e6996fa87419e2aa38067130869d45f781dd20a6f588f2a1

global
    log /dev/log local0
    maxconn 20000
    stats socket /run/haproxy/admin.sock mode 660 level admin expose-fd listeners
    ssl-default-bind-options ssl-min-ver TLSv1.2 no-tls-tickets
    ssl-default-server-options ssl-min-ver TLSv1.2

defaults
    log global
    option dontlognull
    option redispatch
    retries 3
    timeout connect 5s
    timeout client 50s
    timeout server 50s
    timeout http-request 10s
    timeout http-keep-alive 10s
    timeout tunnel 1h

# Local health endpoint for keepalived's check script and the agent's route-health watchdog.
frontend sy_local_health
    mode http
    bind 127.0.0.1:8404
    monitor-uri /healthz
    no log

frontend vs_tls-backends
    mode http
    bind 192.0.2.22:443 ssl crt-list /etc/switchyard/certs/tls-backends.crtlist alpn h2,http/1.1
    option httplog
    option forwardfor
    http-request del-header X-Forwarded-For
    http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Proto https if { ssl_fc }
    http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Proto http if !{ ssl_fc }
    http-request set-var(txn.host) req.hdr(host),field(1,:),lower
    use_backend %[var(txn.host),map(/etc/switchyard/haproxy/maps/tls-backends-host.map)] if { var(txn.host),map(/etc/switchyard/haproxy/maps/tls-backends-host.map) -m found }

backend pool_rancher
    mode http
    balance roundrobin
    server 10-20-2-5-443 10.20.2.5:443 ssl verify required ca-file /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt sni req.hdr(host),field(1,:),lower weight 100

backend pool_ubiquiti
    mode http
    balance roundrobin
    option httpchk
    http-check send meth GET uri /health
    http-check expect status 200
    timeout check 3s
    default-server inter 5s fall 3 rise 2
    server 10-20-2-4-8443 10.20.2.4:8443 check check-ssl ssl verify none sni req.hdr(host),field(1,:),lower weight 100

==> haproxy/maps/tls-backends-host.map (plaintext, whole file)
rancher.example.test pool_rancher
uisp.example.test pool_ubiquiti
